I had been using Samsung Pay during all my time with a Samsung, and it was a great experience. *I never once had a problem while I was using Samsung Pay.* So, I was looking forward to an equal experience with Google Pay... and for a while it was great. For about eight months I used Google Pay everyday. All the retailers around where I work take electronic payment, and I used my HTC mobile to use rewards cards, gift cards, and to pay for items. Every day. After about eight months, Google Pay stopped working, literally over night. One day I was able to use it, the next I was not. When I followed the links I found that my mobile was "not considered secure." enough. It was secure enough the day before, but now it was not. No one can tell me why. All my apps were either pre-installed at the factory, or were downloaded from the PlayStore. No apps from anywhere else. Nothing changed on my mobile from the one day to the next. So, it appears that Google decided arbitrarily to deny me service for no good reason. I installed this app and gave Google a window into my purchasing habits with the understanding that they would, in turn, provide me a service. I no longer am receiving a service from Google in the form of Google Pay, but Google still has the means to track my purchase history. It appears to me that Google has breached the agreement that *they provide me a service in exchange for that information.*. I'm wondering if that agreement is considered to be a contract, and I'm wondering if that contract - implied or explicit - puts Google in an actionable position. I will be keeping an eye out for class-action lawsuits in the hopes of adding my name to it.

raw: I am very disappointed with Google Pay. Recently they have decided that after 10 months of use with their app, I needed to be randomly selected for additional verification. Without warning I was signed out of my app, payments that are sent to me are unable to be accepted. I attempted to follow the on screen prompts that now demand my social security number, a photo ID, picture of a utility bill and more. Every time I reach the end of the process, it just reloads and asks me to redo it all. After 5 attempts, it locked me out and required me to wait for a phone call for assistance. The first phone call let me know that my account needed "human eyes" laid on it, and emailed me a link to yet again, attempt to send in all of the previous information again. In attempting to use this email link, when all information is input, the "submit" button at the end is greyed out. When pressed, nothing happens. No new window that says anything was submitted, no email thanking me for my information. When I requested a second call back, that call let me know that the submit button did in fact work, 3 times. Now I am waiting 24-48 hours for those "human eyes" to look at my info and verify my account so that I can receive my payments. This app is already annoying enough to use without these new issues and timelines to wait on. The layout of the app is not user friendly, it glitches frequently, and requires the use of a password or lock screen on your phone for cards to be saved. It should be MY decision if I choose to have that extra protection of a password on my phone if I want it or not. All in all, if I had a choice, I would choose another payment option instead of Google Pay. Hopefully my business corespondents who choose to use Google Pay will select another route soon and I can migrate out of this ever frustrating app.
